factory_reference: rtk_wifi6.ko validate_recv_ctrl_frame0xb8c00..0xb8c18 distinguishes BAR0x84 and PS-Poll0xa4; ordinary RTS/CTS/ACK/BA do not update receive reorder/PS state.
bug: The normal PE worker classified RTS/CTS/ACK/BA as stateless, but reorder lookahead stopped at those same records and unnecessarily sent the data batch to ARM.
fix: Use the same RX state-barrier classifier in normal dispatch and lookahead. Control records remain unchanged for ARM. BAR/PS-Poll barriers, PN/SN checks, queue bounds and buffer counts remain intact.
verification: The old linked image fails the new interleaved-control case. Modified linked PE passes all four control cases, BAR/PS-Poll negative cases and the existing RX ownership/backpressure cases. NI descriptor credit and actual instruction-memory startup checks also pass.

RAM_measurements.limits: RAM replacement changed client association order: Mac became MACID1 and the other peer MACID2. Read-only timing/capture instrumentation affects TCP measurements. These results do not isolate a throughput gain or prove that all retransmissions are fixed. The once-observed130retransmission condition did not recur in the single aligned capture; it was recorded without repeating until failure or success.

Mac_PHY.interpretation: The observed uplink PHY during this UDP run was1921Mbps, not the2401.9Mbps capability ceiling. DUT RX rate statistics are updated by ARM-delivered frames and do not provide a full PE RX rate histogram.

warm_original_module.note: Read-only BA snapshots show transient reorder occupancy and batch delivery. Empty BA/head-key differences sampled during delivery do not by themselves prove a failed snapshot decision; no PN/SN validity condition was relaxed.
